about: Nearby galaxies with measured (redshift-independent) distances. Distance = median of the peer-reviewed measurements in NED-D (NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database, Steer et al. 2017, version 17.1.2 of 2020); position and object type from NED. Common name and Wikipedia article by title match; diameter (kpc) and morphological type from Wikidata (CC0) where recorded. Columns: NED name, ecliptic lon, lat (deg, J2000), distance (Mpc), number of measurements, most common method, common name, Wikipedia title, diameter (kpc) or null, morphological type or null, NED redshift.
